entry.title: Xenia 0.1.2
entry.summary: **Lower CPU on Gen2 (MPC Live III).** The emulator now runs on the Live III's fast cores (Cortex-A76) instead of drifting onto the slow ones (Cortex-A55), with the DSP, 68k and emulator threads each on a core of their own. Measured on a Live III with 8 voices held: about 58% of a core, was 110%. Nothing else changed. No ROMs included, as before.

entry.title: Xenia 0.1.1
entry.summary: - **Your ROM is kept on upgrade.** Before, installing a new version deleted `xenia/roms/`; it is now kept like the rest of your files. - **ROM check in the installer app.** The plugin declares its ROM files, so the installer app's **Your ROMs and files** step checks each file before copying it into `xenia/roms/`: the 256 kB image (it starts with `C0 DE`), its two 128 kB halves, or an OS update `.mid`. - A Microwave II ROM works too (the same chip layout); the docs now say so. Download: `Xenia-0.

entry.title: Xenia 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **Xenia**, an emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer for Akai MPC Gen2 standalone devices (MPC Live III and kin, aarch64, MPC OS 3.x), built on gearmulator's XT emulation. **You need your own Microwave XT ROM.** None is included. After installing, put the 256 kB image (or its two 128 kB halves, or an OS update `.mid` next to a full ROM) in the plugin folder's `xenia/roms/` and restart the plugin. **Install:** unzip, copy the folder to the device and run `sh install.
